title: Analytic finite-rank corrections for singularly weighted estimates in a computer-assisted proof of 3D Euler singularity
summary: Computer-assisted proofs of self-similar singularity formation for fluid equations often rely on numerically constructed approximate profiles. One effective approach to establishing stability of perturbations around a numerically constructed profile is to perform weighted energy estimates with singular weights near the singularity. However, the weighted norms require exact local vanishing conditions that are not automatically preserved by the equations nor the numerical construction.
